trial_court: 13th Court, Alipore, Matrimonial Suit No. 19 of 1988
case_name: Mousumi Chakraborty vs Subrata Guha Roy
facts_of_case: Appellant was a student who developed a friendly relation with the respondent. The respondent's parents arranged her marriage, but he confined her against her will and got her to sign a false registration form.

legal_principles.principle: Marriage under the Hindu Marriage Act must be solemnised in accordance with customary rites and ceremonies.
legal_principles.held: Marriage under the Act, must be solemnised in accordance with the customary rites and ceremonies.

legal_principles.principle: Conclusivity of proof requires performance of essential rites and ceremonies.
legal_principles.held: If the ceremonies for Hindu Marriage Act laid down in Section 7 of the Act had not been performed, mere registration, exchange of love letters and producing of photograph are not conclusive proof for holding that a valid marriage took place under the law.

keywords: Latin maxim: Nemo judex in causa sua
use_for_drafting: drafting a petition under Section 12 of the Hindu Marriage Act
responding to a nullity plea in a matrimonial suit
advising on the validity of a marriage ceremony
